head_commit.message:
docs(adr): ADR-KERNEL-09 PROPOSED, control-plane authorization through the GovernanceKernel (DEBT-025)

The owner's Nov 2 decision made control-plane governance a mandatory follow-up, with its own design,
required before DEBT-025 can close. This is that design. PROPOSED only: not accepted, not implemented.

Grounded in the code on main 2491ae4 (every fact cited with a line number): the kernel approves any action
type no governor recognises (opposite of fail-closed), GovernanceAction has no actor or resource field,
the kernel does not persist decisions, interface/api.py never calls it, and EventStream.append is durable
and raises on failure. Proposes a default-deny control.* governor, an explicit principal attached by the
auth middleware, one authorization service as the only API call site, an authorize-before-side-effect rule,
a durable decision record that must succeed before approval, a route-coverage test, and a 12-item test
plan mapped to the owner's five requirements. Five decisions are left to the owner (§9).
Does not touch DEBT-025's status.

head_commit.message:
fix(api-auth): security headers on rejected responses; private token directory when rotation runs first

Two small defects found in review of 8552ca6, both reproduced before fixing:
- Authentication is the outermost middleware, so a rejection (400 Host, 401, 503) never reached
  SecurityHeadersMiddleware and carried none of the four security headers. _reject() now adds the same set.
  Authentication stays outermost.
- rotate_token() created the token directory with a plain mkdir, so on a fresh frozen install
  'ocbrain token --rotate' before the first server start left the per-user directory 0755 (first start made it
  0700). Both paths now go through one helper, _ensure_token_dir(): the frozen per-user default is 0700; an
  existing directory is never chmod-ed; a directory chosen with OCBRAIN_API_TOKEN_FILE keeps the default mode.

Tests: 4 rejection cases + the 503 case + rotate-first + two pins of unchanged behaviour. Against 8552ca6 the six
behavioural tests fail.

head_commit.message:
docs(adr-kernel-08): record owner acceptance of §8.1 item 1, verified chronology, evidence scope

Documentation only. No code, test, harness or policy change. Baseline: main 2491ae4.

Records the owner's explicit acceptance (Nov 1, 2026, after PR #93 merged at
03:23:47Z) of the delegated review of live_citation_check.py as satisfying
ADR-KERNEL-08 §8.1 item 1, with its scope and non-claims, in a new §8.3. The
approved §§1-8.1 are byte-identical.

Corrects 14 mislabelled dates: records of the Nov 1 events (PR #93 merge,
IMPLEMENTED, CTX-AUTH-002 closure) carried "Oct 31, 2026"; GitHub merged_at is
2026-11-01T03:23:47Z (PR #93) and 2026-11-01T12:31:28Z (PR #106). Accurate Oct 31
events (the experiment, 099a238, 396e374) are left as they were. Listed in §8.3.6.

Restates the Oct 31 real-model experiment with its limits: one local model;
harness-defined ESCALATED=0 is not a count of Plan Compiler
GovernanceVerdict.ESCALATE and the harness does not exercise compile or execute;
R3 is 10 of 30 trials (10 prompts x 3), a fallback-selection outcome with the
user-visible cost unassessed and no valid baseline; git_commit=unknown and the
exit status were not captured and are not repaired by inference.

Re-audits R1-R6 against main: the two helpers that read the steered fields
(build_capability_discovery_request, build_planner_request) have no production
call site; Orchestrator.handle() builds PlannerRequest directly. Adds dated,
additive supersession notes to the K4.2 completion report and the contract-
evolution spec (bodies unchanged) and a clarification to the threat model.

ADR-KERNEL-08 stays IMPLEMENTED, not FINAL: no finalization criteria are defined
anywhere in the repo, so none is met or invented. CTX-AUTH-002 stays CLOSED
(qualified); CTX-AUTH-001b stays OPEN; REM-004, REM-002, DEBT-025 untouched.

head_commit.message:
docs(DEBT-025): record what the real Windows run showed (E12) and correct A12

The report claimed a new token file on Windows ends with exactly one ACL entry. The real run disproved it
(explicit SYSTEM/Administrators/OWNER RIGHTS entries; /grant:r leaves other explicit entries). Records the
observed facts, the changed invariant and recipe, and the limits of that evidence (one runner, built-in
Administrator, English names, listing not a cross-account read).
